author: Redditenmo
body:
I use this for **Chimera** endless farming: https://imgur.com/a/kpFzGSx

Of note, there's a fair amount of follower / gear swapping required to get all the buffs.

1. Enter with Divine bastion follower.
2. Swap offhand staff for a **Book of the Dragon**
3. Once you've got dragon / all elemental resists Equip **Treecutter** for Gymir Stance
3. Swap to secondary class that has Raider spec (for berserk 3)
 - note, If you have **Peluda, Poison Quilled** follower this can also give berserk 3 buff
4. Swap to back to BeoA and get **Chimera** follower.
5. Once health goes under 50% from dots, cast Call of Jord II
6. Once you've got 50% redline buff, eat a zerk mushroom for berserk 2
7. drink small mana pots until you die.

My Endless record with this is mid 500s.     
Note: For endless I only run in Anguish 1.  
Note 2: I'm currently swapping my armor adorns to **Eye of Osiris**

It's likely I could go deeper with the new Yggdrasil follower, but I've not started trying yet.
